in_arabic.name: فُعْدَان
in_arabic.meaning: معنى اسم فُعْدَان هو قلب فائض
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فُعْدَان من أصل عربي،  بمعنى "القلب الفائض" أو "القلب المكرم".  يُشير إلى قلبٌ مليء بالمحبة، والكرم، والعطاء. ويُعتبر اسم فُعْدَان من الأسماء النادرة في العالم العربي، ولكنه يحمل معنى دلاليًّا قويًّا.

in_urdu.name: فُعْدَان
in_urdu.meaning: فُعْدَان کا معنی ہے دل کا خوبصورت اور بڑھ کر چڑھنا.
in_urdu.long_meaning: فُعْدَان ایک نادر اور دلکش اسم ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے "دل کا خوبصورت اور بڑھ کر چڑھنا". یہ اسم عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں "فُعْد“ کا مطلب ہے دل اور "ان“ ایک اضافہ ہے۔ یہ نام ایک بڑا دل، کریم، اور محبت کرنے والے شخص کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फुआदन
in_hindi.meaning: फुआदन का अर्थ है दिल का प्रचुर (풍요로운) होना.
in_hindi.long_meaning: फुआदन एक अरबी मूल का अनोखा और सुंदर नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'दिल का प्रचुर होना' या 'दिल का विशाल होना'. यह नाम मुस्लिम संस्कृति में प्रचलित है और एक दयालु, करुणामय और भक्तीमय व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: فؤادان
in_pashto.meaning: فؤادان د لوب د خوشوب و کښتن معنا کوي.
in_pashto.long_meaning: فؤادان په پشتو ته د لوب د خوشوب و کښتن معنا کوي. د دې نوم په عربي ژبه پورې د "فؤاد“ لومړۍ په معنا د لوب ته. د فؤادان نوم په عوامي ډول په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د بېلابېلو اجتماعي ټولنې کې ورکول کېږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fuadan carries a deep sense of respect and admiration in Islamic culture due to its root meaning. In many Muslim societies, wisdom and knowledge are highly cherished qualities. A Fuadan is considered to be a person who is wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable, and is often looked up to as a respected figure and a source of guidance. The name inspires a natural desire for acquiring knowledge and pursuing wisdom, which is a fundamental aspect of Islamic belief.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fuadan reflects the Islamic concept of wisdom as a means of approaching God and understanding His divine will. In the Quran, wisdom is mentioned numerous times as a guiding light, a treasure, and a means of seeking knowledge of God and His creation. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is also referred to as the "Wise" or "Knowing" one, emphasizing the importance of wisdom and knowledge in Islam. Thus, the name Fuadan can be seen as a reminder of the importance of seeking wisdom and knowledge as a means of connecting with God and leading a meaningful and purposeful life.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'Al-'Ibar: A General History of the World', Chapter 8: The Berbers and the Foundation of the Maghrib
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun mentioned 'Fuadan' among the Berber tribes inhabiting the Maghrib region. He described them as 'a people of the mountains, living in the Aures (Aurès) of the Maghrib'. Ibn Khaldun also noted that the Fuadan were known for their knowledge of the art of fortune-telling and used to inhabit the area around present-day Algiers.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Idrisi's 'The Description of the World', Chapter 1: The Maghrib The name Fuadan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi mentioned the Fuadan tribe living in the Maghrib region, specifically in the area of present-day Tunisia. He described them as 'a people of good character, industrious, living in the highlands and the mountains'. Al-Idrisi also noted that their principal city was 'Fadhaj', which is believed to be the present-day town of Fadhaj, Tunisia.
